info.title: Prelude
info.author: Nextendo Network
info.description: Switch between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.
info.details:
Prelude is a Nintendo Switch homebrew application for switching an Atmosphere console between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.

Nextendo mode configures the Atmosphere files and patches needed to connect supported games and services to Nextendo Network. Nintendo mode removes Prelude's changes and restores the console's normal Nintendo network configuration.

Prelude applies its changes through files and settings that Atmosphere reads at boot, making the process reversible. After selecting a network mode, the console reboots so the new configuration can take effect.

changelog:
v4.0.3

## Prelude v4.0.3 — fixes the Pokémon Sword/Shield crash when connecting from Y-Comm

On console, pressing **+** in the Y-Comm to connect to the internet crashed **Pokémon Sword** and **Pokémon Shield** (1.3.2) with error **2124-0400**.

The game asks the console what kind of Nintendo Switch Online membership the user has, and closes itself if that check fails. Prelude already works around the same check for Pokémon Scarlet/Violet, Legends: Z-A and Minecraft Dungeons II; this release adds the same small patch for Sword and Shield (`pkmnswsh-nextendo/`).

### What you need to do
1. Update Prelude.
2. Open Prelude and select **Nextendo** mode again so the new patch is copied to your SD card.
3. Restart the console, then start the game.

### Who needs this
Anyone playing Pokémon Sword or Shield **1.3.2** online on a console. Emulator players are not affected.

### Tested
The crash and its cause were confirmed from an Atmosphère crash report (Shield 1.3.2). The patched build has not been tested on a console yet.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NextendoNetwork/Prelude-Nextendo/compare/v4.0.2...v4.0.3
